Scientific calculator simulator

Source: https://github.com/simoncragg/scientific-calculator
Upstream revision: 0ae021d
Copyright (c) 2024 Simon Cragg
MIT License — see LICENSE.txt in this directory.

Independent Casio-inspired fx-82TS simulator; not official Casio software.

Local adaptations: isolated offline build; local math labels instead of a MathJax CDN;
viewport scaling; physical keyboard input; saved session state; working memory/Ans
keys; power operator; defensive handling of invalid calculations.

Editable source and upstream tests: vendor/casio-simulator in the application repository.
